info.name: CMS Blue Button 2.0 Coverage Patient API
Search the authorized beneficiary's Patient resource

params.name: _id
params.description: The FHIR logical id of the Patient resource.

params.name: identifier
params.description: Search by business identifier (Medicare Beneficiary Identifier hash system identifiers).

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description: Filter by the record's last_updated date using gt/lt prefixes; may be supplied more than once to define a range.

params.name: _count
params.description: Number of records per page for pagination.

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return for pagination.

items.docs: Returns the beneficiary's demographic and administrative record as a Patient resource in a FHIR Bundle. Available only if the beneficiary chose to share demographic data during authorization.

info.name: Read the beneficiary's Patient resource by id

params.name: id
params.description: The FHIR logical id of the resource.

items.docs: Returns the Patient resource for the authorizing beneficiary.
